statusText: EA_ON / green: Nasdaq futures are modestly firmer and crude is lower, while elevated Treasury yields and geopolitical uncertainty keep Stress extreme; no verified granular NQ sequence shows persistent mean-reversion failure.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains below WATCH; the U.S. cash-open transition is the principal conditional path-risk checkpoint.
headline: Measured tech strength and easing oil keep Tail low while high yields sustain extreme Stress
body: Reuters reported Nasdaq futures up 0.6%, S&P 500 futures up 0.4%, the U.S. 2-year yield near 4.7604%, and WTI near $98.15 as Middle East oil flows improved. Fresh reporting still does not provide a granular NQ sequence proving repeated extension, shallow pullbacks, or session-extreme holding.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 UTC clock-hours, Tail was mostly 15-19% / green, briefly rose to WATCH at the Sunday futures reopening, then returned to 19-17% / green as available evidence remained orderly and no persistent mean-reversion failure was verified.
outlookSummary: Tail is low in the current hour because available evidence shows only a measured futures gain rather than a persistent one-way NQ path. The main conditional WATCH window is 12:00-15:00 UTC around the U.S. cash-open transition, with a narrower 19:00 UTC power-hour checkpoint.

forecast.analysis: Fresh Reuters reporting has Nasdaq futures up 0.6% and S&P futures up 0.4%, with WTI near $98.15 and the U.S. 2-year yield near 4.7604%. No granular NQ sequence verifies persistent extension, failed retracements, or session-extreme holding.
drivers: Nasdaq futures +0.6% in fresh Reuters reporting
Granular NQ mean-reversion-failure evidence is unavailable

news.title: Morning Bid: More oil is flowing, depending on who you ask
Tech leads shares higher in Asia as oil slips

forecast.analysis: If the measured tech bid persists without repeated extension, Tail remains low. Thin Japanese holiday liquidity and elevated front-end yields keep Stress high, while easing crude reduces one immediate amplifier.

European participation is the next conditional test. Broader equity confirmation with normal retracements would support low Tail; a one-way NQ path with shallow pullbacks would be the main reason for escalation.
drivers: Retracement depth remains the main Tail discriminator

forecast.analysis: As European liquidity deepens, the rate backdrop and Gulf headlines keep Stress extreme. Tail stays below WATCH unless directional efficiency strengthens and pullbacks fail repeatedly.
drivers: High U.S. yields remain a growth-equity headwind

forecast.analysis: The Europe-to-U.S. handoff begins to matter more. A stable futures gain with two-way trade would keep Tail low; repeated extension into the U.S. premarket would raise concern.
drivers: Repeated extension would be the key conditional warning

forecast.analysis: Austan Goolsbee is scheduled to speak at 10:30 UTC. The event raises headline sensitivity and Stress, but Tail stays low unless any reaction becomes persistent and resists meaningful retracement.
drivers: Event importance alone does not establish Tail

forecast.analysis: After the scheduled Fed remarks, the focus shifts toward U.S. premarket price discovery. Two-way repricing would keep Tail below WATCH; failed pullbacks would be the main adverse signal.
drivers: Failed pullbacks would be the main Tail escalation trigger

forecast.analysis: The hour enters the primary pre-open danger window. Tail moves to WATCH conditionally because gap formation can become more efficient here, while rates, geopolitics, and trade headlines remain active amplifiers.
drivers: Rates and geopolitical headlines can amplify a directional move

forecast.analysis: The U.S. cash open is the highest-risk conditional checkpoint. Tail reaches the top of WATCH only if opening-auction structure is forceful; sustained extension with shallow pullbacks would be needed for an elevated state.
drivers: Shallow pullbacks would be the critical conditional signal
Elevated yields can reinforce growth-stock moves

forecast.analysis: The second cash-session hour remains in WATCH as opening imbalances can persist. A meaningful retracement or loss of directional efficiency would support rapid normalization; repeated extension would keep risk elevated.
Tail remains in WATCH at the edge of the danger window. The key condition is whether the opening move broadens into persistent one-way structure or instead develops ordinary two-way retracements.
drivers: Breadth and semis matter only as confirmation

forecast.analysis: Beyond the opening window, the base case returns below WATCH if retracements are visible and cross-asset pressure is not reinforcing. Headline Stress remains high because rates and Gulf risks are unresolved.
drivers: Rates and Gulf risks keep Stress elevated

forecast.analysis: Mid-session conditions normally favor more balanced trade. Tail remains low unless a renewed catalyst produces repeated extension or the index begins holding near session extremes without meaningful pullback.
drivers: Session-extreme holding would be an adverse signal

forecast.analysis: The afternoon base case remains two-way. Elevated yields can still pressure growth equities, but without persistent price-path confirmation they primarily sustain Stress rather than Tail.
drivers: Price-path confirmation is required for higher Tail

forecast.analysis: Power hour creates a narrow WATCH checkpoint. Tail rises only conditionally because late-session continuation can become efficient; normal pullbacks or reversal behavior would quickly reduce the path-risk state.
drivers: Normal reversal or pullback behavior would reduce Tail

forecast.analysis: Around the cash close, Tail falls below WATCH in the base case if no persistent late-session extension develops. Closing imbalances can still keep Stress elevated without implying a pathological path.
Early post-close trade should carry less directional information. Tail stays low unless a new corporate, geopolitical, or policy headline creates a fresh one-way repricing impulse.
drivers: No scheduled major U.S. release in this hour

forecast.analysis: The evening futures session is expected to be thinner. The base case remains low Tail, with higher Stress reflecting unresolved rates and geopolitical uncertainty rather than observed mean-reversion failure.

As Asia begins to participate, cross-market confirmation becomes more informative. Tail remains low unless Nasdaq futures start extending persistently while yields, oil, or regional tech move in the same direction.
If Asia opens without a fresh shock, the lower-liquidity overnight base case favors normal two-way structure. Persistent directional efficiency would be needed to lift Tail from low levels.
drivers: No scheduled U.S. catalyst in this hour
Directional efficiency would be the main invalidation

forecast.analysis: The overnight session remains low Tail in the base case. Ongoing diplomatic and oil headlines keep Stress high, but they do not imply a one-way Nasdaq path without fresh price confirmation.
drivers: Oil and diplomacy remain headline drivers
Fresh price confirmation is required for Tail escalation

forecast.analysis: Absent a new shock, the late-Asia window remains a low-Tail period. The main watchpoint is whether cross-asset moves begin aligning with a persistent Nasdaq futures trend.
drivers: No observed future path is assumed

forecast.analysis: Approaching the next European morning, Tail remains low conditionally. A fresh rates or geopolitical repricing could raise Stress first; Tail would require sustained directional structure.

The next European open approaches, modestly lifting conditional Tail because liquidity and cross-asset participation increase. The state remains below WATCH unless a one-way futures path is already developing by then.
drivers: One-way futures structure would be the key escalation condition

forecastDetail.comment: Current evidence shows a measured positive futures tone, easing crude and no verified persistent NQ mean-reversion failure.
Low Tail persists if the overnight tech bid remains measured; yields and thin liquidity keep Stress elevated.
European participation is the next test, with retracement quality more important than headline importance.
Deeper European liquidity keeps Stress high, but Tail remains low without repeated extension or failed pullbacks.
The Europe-to-U.S. handoff modestly lifts sensitivity; persistent one-way efficiency remains conditional.
Goolsbee's scheduled remarks raise event sensitivity, while Tail remains low absent persistent post-event structure.
